Nonnegative initial states and positive fixed mass-action rates are necessary.

value.rationale: Structural closure records the same immediate binary presence for networks with dramatically different quantitative observability. The theorem supplies the exact first nonzero time derivative, a positive leading coefficient, and a rate-independent finite combinatorial algorithm. The sharp worst-case onset order grows exponentially as 2^s-1 even for binary reactant stoichiometry, giving a mathematically motivated obstacle to inferring apparent delays or detection precision from closure alone. This is an all-sizes sharp invariant for natural mass-action kinetics, not an arbitrary finite census or routine numerical increment; it does not claim absolute thresholds or long-time behavior.
